parameter_set.description: PyBaMM 26.10.1.1's Mohtat2020 parameter set, for a graphite/NMC532 pouch cell (Mohtat et al. 2020). Exported to BPX by battinfo-records (scripts/export-pybamm-bpx.py).

notes: Parameter values from https://doi.org/10.1149/1945-7111/aba5d1 as implemented in PyBaMM's Mohtat2020 parameter set (PyBaMM 26.10.1.1, BSD-3-Clause), exported to BPX by battinfo-records.
Matches PyBaMM 26.10.1.1's native set within 0.38 mV RMS and 0.005% capacity (DFN discharges from 0.05C to 2C, and at 1C 20 K warmer).
PyBaMM's Mohtat2020 starts at a state of charge of 0.0002. The file starts it at 1, so that the standard discharges have charge to deliver.
